subject: Request: mid-contract capacity addition & co-term pricing

Subject: Mid-contract capacity add — need pricing and co-term options

Hi Jonas,

We hope you had a good weekend. Quick one — our usage for the pilot has outgrown the committed capacity faster than expected. We have an internal request to add 200k inference tokens/month to our Dedicated pool starting April 1 and we'd like to understand:

- How you handle mid-contract uplifts (proration, billing start date)
- What discounts (if any) apply for incremental committed capacity mid-term
- Options for co-terming so our renewal stays aligned to Jan 31, 2027 (instead of creating a separate anniversary date)

I've attached a short request summary (ClearEdu_MCP_request_20260301.pdf) — can you share a rough price/quote and timeline? This is time sensitive for our budget review on Mar 10.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Director, Platform Engineering
ClearEdu
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clearedu.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@clearedu.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity add — need pricing and co-term options

Sophie — thanks for the note and the attachment. Quick ack — we'll put together a short proposal. Couple clarifying Qs to make sure we size the uplift correctly:

1) Is the 200k tokens/month a permanent increase to committed capacity, or a temporary burst for Q2?
2) Do you want the additional capacity added to the same Dedicated pool/tenant or a separate bucket for testing?

If it's permanent and same pool, we typically offer:
- Prorated billing from the change effective date (we'd bill the remainder of the month pro rata)
- A mid-term uplift discount band depending on total committed volume (we can apply an uplift tier discount of 5–12% on the incremental units depending on the size)
- Co-terming to align future renewals is standard — we can co-term the uplift to your Jan 31, 2027 renewal date and prorate the final invoice accordingly.

I'll draft a firm quote and run it by Laura for approval; can you confirm Q1 above?

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clearedu.com>

Subject: Re: Mid-contract capacity add — need pricing and co-term options

Thanks Jonas — apologies for the ambiguity. The 200k is expected to be permanent (we're moving a production workload into the pool). Please apply to the same Dedicated pool.

One more: our procurement prefers single renewal dates for all capacity. If we co-term the uplift to Jan 31, 2027, will the effective price for the uplift simply be prorated through Jan 31 and then bill at renewal rates? Any penalty or minimum commitment change?

Appreciate a written quote we can review with procurement.
Sophie
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 14:10:00 -0000
Subject: Proposal: ClearEdu mid-contract uplift — pricing & co-term option (draft)

Hi Sophie / Marcus —

Attached is a draft proposal (proposal_uplift_pricing_jonas_20260303.xlsx). Key points below — summarizing for procurement: 

1) Scope: Permanent +200k tokens/month added to existing Dedicated commitment, effective 2026-04-01.

2) Pricing (incremental units only):
- Base incremental rate (list): $0.0009 per token
- Applied uplift discount: 10% on incremental units (volume band: +150k–300k) 
- Effective incremental rate after discount: $0.00081 per token

3) Proration & co-term mechanics: 
- Billing will start pro rata on 2026-04-01 for the remainder of the March invoice period (we will include a one-time prorated charge on the next invoice dated 2026-04-05).
- We will co-term the uplift to your master renewal date of 2027-01-31. The co-term does not impose additional penalties; the uplift simply joins your existing commitment and will renew at the negotiated renewal rates at Jan 31, 2027 unless a separate renegotiation occurs.

4) Contract language / amendment: 
- We will issue an amendment (no change to other license terms) that lists the added committed capacity and the pro-rated first charge. Signing the amendment adds the capacity and the associated monthly committed charges.

5) Time to execute: Delivery of signed amendment within 5 business days -> changes live within one billing cycle.

6) Optional: If you prefer to lock a longer-term uplift discount, we can offer a 12% discount if you commit to the added capacity through 2028-01-31 (two-way co-term). Let me know if you want that included.

Next steps I propose: 
- Sophie: confirm you accept the 10% uplift discount on the incremental 200k and the April 1 effective date.
- I'll generate the amendment and email it to Marcus and your procurement team plus upload to DocuSign.

Thanks — attaching the spreadsheet with line-item math. Happy to jump on a 15-min call today if helpful.

— Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
